copy.curiosityHook: Raised deep in the Amazon, how will young Mimi-Siku handle the towering rush and strange rules of the French capital?
copy.description: Seeking a divorce to remarry, trader Stephen tracks his ex-wife to the Amazon, only to discover a son he never knew existed. When the boy longs to see Paris, Stephen reluctantly brings him home for a brief visit.
copy.vibeSummary: Lighthearted, comic, and warm-spirited, offering an accessible 90-minute family clash of cultures.
copy.whyWatch: Directed by Hervé Palud, this breezy French family comedy blends classic fish-out-of-water humor with genuine warmth as jungle life collides head-on with urban routine.

allowedMaterial: Stephen travels to the Amazon to get a divorce from his ex-wife Patricia so he can marry Charlotte.
Stephen discovers he has a son, Mimi-Siku, raised in the jungle.
Stephen reluctantly agrees to take Mimi-Siku to Paris for a few days.
excludedMaterial: Resolution of Stephen's engagement to Charlotte
Third-act events and climax in Paris
Final fate of Mimi-Siku and his relationship with his parents
Specific late-story gags or ending scenes
